title: The Whisper of Ten Thousand Years
next_chapter_hook: Deep within the Mental Sea, that unfamiliar seal trembled slightly, as if something was awakening. Su Qingyao's exclamation rang in his ears—Chen Ji felt his consciousness being forcibly pulled by some kind of force.

text.content: That voice came from ancient times: 'You've finally reached this point, the seventh Chess Player.' Chen Ji's body shuddered. The Tianji Record Fragment in his Mental Sea actually opened on its own, golden light dragging his consciousness into a chaotic Void. Dust from ten thousand years ago rushed toward him, carrying the intertwined scent of decay and vicissitudes. A blurry figure slowly formed in the Void.

Chen Ji pressed down his churning emotions and looked around. He had glimpsed this Void in the fragmentary memories of the page, but never so clearly. Countless points of light floated in the Void, each connected to a thread of destiny, weaving into an enormous chess web. And he stood precisely at the center of this web.

dialogue.content: 'The seventh... Is it finally your turn?' That voice emerged from the fragment on Chen Ji's chest, carrying an indescribably complex emotion. 'I've waited for this moment, waited far too long.'

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul manifested from the fragment. His illusory form was even more faint than before, as if he might dissipate into nothingness at any moment. Chen Ji noticed tears glistening in his eyes—that was an emotion only an existence that had waited ten thousand years would show upon seeing hope.

dialogue.content: 'Mo Xiansheng, what does this 'seventh Chess Player' mean?' Chen Ji's voice was steady, but his clenched fists revealed the turmoil in his heart. 'What exactly happened ten thousand years ago?'

text.content: Mo Xiansheng waved his hand, and a massive stone tablet appeared in the Void. The tablet was covered with ancient writing—some Chen Ji recognized, others completely unfamiliar. But the most shocking was the line of blood-red characters at the tablet's summit—'List of Chess Players,' with seven names written beneath.
'First: Taixu True Man. Second: Tianmingzi. Third: Xuanji Taoist...' Chen Ji's voice trembled slightly. 'Fourth, Fifth, Sixth names are all unclear, but at the seventh position... it's blank.'

dialogue.content: 'That is not blank,' Mo Xiansheng's voice was low and grieved. 'It is that you have not yet seen it. The name of the seventh Chess Player was erased by Heavenly Dao itself. Because his identity was too special—special to the point that even the record itself was taboo.'

text.content: Just as Chen Ji was about to press further, the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly vibrated violently. A line of ancient characters appeared凭空浮现在虚空之中——那是比石碑上的文字更加古老的铭文，金色字迹仿佛燃烧的火焰，灼得陈机的识海隐隐作痛。

Chen Ji stared at that line of text, each character like a blade, mercilessly cutting into his heart. 'As long as the bloodline does not perish, the chess game shall not end. The seventh Chess Player shall bear the surname Chen, the name Ji, and shall awaken after ten thousand years to restart Heavenly Secrets.'

dialogue.content: 'Chen...' Chen Ji's voice was hoarse. 'The Chen family?' He thought of his sister Chen Nian, who had been missing for years, and his father's inexplicable words before death—'Our Chen family owes this heaven and earth an answer.'

choice.prompt: The truth from ten thousand years ago gradually emerged. Chen Ji discovered he was a key piece in some ancient chess game. How should he respond at this moment?

choices.description: Demand Mo Xiansheng tell everything about what happened ten thousand years ago, no matter how cruel the truth might be.
choices.risk_hint: The Truth May Be Heavier Than Imagined

dialogue.content: 'Speak clearly!' Chen Ji's voice was cold as frost. 'What exactly happened ten thousand years ago? What connection does my Chen family have with this 'Ultimate Chess Player'? What is his purpose?'

text.content: Mo Xiansheng remained silent for a long time, his illusory form trembling violently. Finally, he spoke: 'Ten thousand years ago, the first generation Chess Player discovered Heavenly Dao's secret—所谓的天道，不过是一个被困禁了无数岁月的意识体，它需要不断吞噬天才的命运来维持自身存在。'

choices.description: Immediately contact Su Qingyao and ask her to help verify the connection between the Chen family and history from ten thousand years ago.
choices.visible_cost: Expose the Existence of the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: May Put Su Qingyao in Danger

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, pulling his consciousness out of the Tianji Record's Void. He opened his eyes to find Su Qingyao looking at him with worry. Those clear eyes were full of concern, touching a corner of his heart.

choices.description: Suppress the churning emotions in his heart and digest this shocking truth alone before making plans.
choices.visible_cost: Miss the Opportunity to Obtain Information
choices.risk_hint: May Fall into an Information Cocoon

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, forcibly suppressing the surging emotions. No matter how complex this ten-thousand-year chess game was, the only thing he could do now was see further than others and think more deeply.

Mo Xiansheng's voice continued echoing in the Mental Sea: 'The first generation Chess Player tried to break this cycle but was counterattacked by Heavenly Dao, turning into nothingness. However, before his fall, he sealed part of his true spirit into the Tianji Record and left behind seven inheritances... Seven sparks, waiting for the day they could blaze across all heavens.'

Chen Ji felt a wave of dizziness. He remembered the scene when he obtained the Tianji Record Fragment—at his father's grave, a golden light broke through the earth and directly entered his Brow Center. At the time, he thought it was an inheritance left by his father, but looking at it now, everything was destined ten thousand years ago.

dialogue.content: 'You are the seventh Chess Player, and also the last.' Mo Xiansheng's tone became grave. 'Because the Tianji Record has seven pages, corresponding to seven inheritances. When the Chess Player of the seventh page falls, Heavenly Dao will completely lose its restraint. At that time...'

text.content: Chen Ji raised his head abruptly, his gaze sharp as a blade: 'What will happen at that time?' Mo Xiansheng's form grew increasingly illusory, as if he might dissipate at any moment. He looked at Chen Ji, his eyes full of complex emotions—expectation, guilt, and deep reluctance.

dialogue.content: 'At that time, heaven and earth will return to chaos. And you, as the last Chess Player, will face the only choice—' Mo Xiansheng's voice grew quieter. 'Either become Heavenly Dao's new puppet, or... perish together with Heavenly Dao.'

text.content: The Void in the Mental Sea began to collapse. Countless threads of destiny broke and reorganized. Chen Ji felt a tremendous repulsive force pushing him outward. In the instant before his consciousness returned to reality, he saw that at the seventh name on the stone tablet, a blurry outline finally appeared—that was an infant's imprint, identical to the birthmark on his chest.

Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes, cold sweat soaking his inner shirt. Su Qingyao was tightly gripping his hand, her eyes full of worry. She had clearly sensed something unusual and was about to ask, but suddenly froze—her gaze fell on Chen Ji's Brow Center, her pupils contracting sharply.

dialogue.content: 'Chen Ji, what is that seal in your Mental Sea?' Su Qingyao's voice trembled slightly. 'It just... moved.'

text.content: Chen Ji's heart tightened. He immediately sank his consciousness into the Mental Sea and indeed saw that beside the original Tianji Record Fragment, an unfamiliar seal was quietly floating. The seal was dark purple, its surface carved with runes even older than the Tianji Record, pulsing微微跳动着，仿佛有心跳一般。
Chen Ji attempted to touch that seal using the power of the Tianji Record, but felt an extremely cold aura透出，让他瞬间僵住。那一刻，他听到了一个声音——不是墨先生的，也不是天机录的，而是来自封印深处，一个陌生而古老的存在。

That voice was cold and mocking: 'Welcome to the real chess game, seventh Chess Player. You lost once ten thousand years ago. This time... I hope you can last longer.' As the voice fell, the seal trembled slightly, and an information stream forcibly flooded into Chen Ji's Mental Sea—that was the truth about the first generation Chess Player's fall.
Chen Ji死死咬住舌尖，用疼痛强迫自己保持清醒。苏青瑶已经察觉到了异常，她的手紧紧握着他的手腕，指尖微微发凉。他知道自己必须尽快做出决定——那道封印正在以肉眼可见的速度扩张，仿佛有什么东西即将破壳而出。

choice.prompt: A mysterious seal not belonging to the Tianji Record appeared in the Mental Sea. That cold voice implied a deeper conspiracy. How should Chen Ji respond to this sudden change?

choices.description: Mobilize all the power of the Tianji Record to attempt to suppress this unfamiliar seal.
choices.risk_hint: May Anger the Entity Within the Seal

text.content: Chen Ji let out a low roar. The Tianji Record Fragment erupted with unprecedented radiance, golden runes surging toward that dark purple seal like a tide. The two forces collided激烈 in the Mental Sea. Chen Ji felt his head splitting with pain but gritted his teeth and persevered.

choices.description: Temporarily do not suppress the seal, but carefully尝试与其沟通，获取更多信息。

text.content: Chen Ji endured the intense pain in his Mental Sea, slowly moving his consciousness toward that seal. The runes on the seal's surface seemed to sense something, glowing微微，散发出一种诡异而诱惑的光芒。

choices.description: Let Su Qingyao use her special abilities to help stabilize the Mental Sea and face this threat together.

text.content: Chen Ji opened his eyes and looked at Su Qingyao. The worry and determination in her gaze made a certain solid barrier in his heart微微松动。 He said softly: 'Qingyao, I need your help.'

Upon hearing Chen Ji's words, a flash of surprise crossed Su Qingyao's eyes, soon replaced by determination. She didn't ask questions, simply placing her hands on Chen Ji's temples. A cool spiritual power flooded into his Mental Sea. This force was gentle yet firm, like a barrier, temporarily blocking the seal's expansion.

Chen Ji felt the pressure in his Mental Sea suddenly lessen. He took the opportunity to examine that seal again and discovered a symbol faintly visible at its core—an unfamiliar yet mysteriously familiar pattern, as if it were an ancient family crest.

Just then, Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded again, this time with unprecedented gravity: 'Chen Ji, that seal... is the 'Eye of Surveillance' Heavenly Dao forcibly implanted into your bloodline when the first generation Chess Player fell ten thousand years ago. It has been sleeping all along, only awakening when you touch the core truth...'

The four characters 'Eye of Surveillance' fell like a basin of cold water. Chen Ji felt a bone-piercing chill—turns out from the beginning, he had been watched. No matter how carefully he laid plans, how meticulously he used the Tianji Record's abilities, there was a pair of eyes from ten thousand years ago watching him.

Su Qingyao's spiritual power flowed through the Mental Sea. She seemed to sense the seal's existence as well. She didn't ask, just concentrated on输送灵力 more devotedly. Those clear eyes were full of trust and determination. Complex emotions surged in Chen Ji's heart—this woman, time and time again, chose to stand by his side, even knowing what following him meant.
Chen Ji took a deep breath and made his decision. He moved his consciousness微微靠近那道封印，尝试与其沟通。封印中的存在似乎感知到了他的意图，传来一个阴冷的声音：'想谈判？你没有资格。不过...看在你这么有趣的份上，我可以给你一个机会。'封印微微颤动，一段画面强行涌入陈机的意识——那是第一代执棋者陨落的场景。

In the image, a figure bathed in blood stood in the Void. His features bore a seventy percent resemblance to Chen Ji, yet carried more vicissitudes and heroism. Surrounding him were seven figures—manifestations of Heavenly Dao's will, each possessing the power to destroy worlds. The first generation Chess Player laughedlong and loud, his voice full of resolve: 'Heavenly Dao, you cannot imprison my will through ten thousand cycles of reincarnation!'

Then, that figure self-destructed. In the earth-shattering explosion, all seven Heavenly Dao manifestations were simultaneously destroyed. Heaven and earth changed color. And in that instant, a faint glimmer imperceptible to the naked eye flew from the explosion's center, entering the mortal world below—the trajectory of that light ultimately pointed to a pregnant woman carrying a new life.

Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes, his entire body trembling. He finally understood—his bloodline was never accidental. The first generation Chess Player's choice ten thousand years ago made the Chen family generation after generation part of this chess game. And he, as the seventh Chess Player, from the moment of birth, had already stood at the storm's center.
Deep within the Mental Sea, that dark purple seal trembled微微，仿佛感应到了陈机的情绪波动。苏青瑶的手依然覆在他的太阳穴上，清凉的灵力持续涌入，勉强压制住了封印扩张的势头。但陈机知道，这只是暂时的——那道'监视之眼'已经苏醒，它背后的存在正在等待着什么。

Su Qingyao spoke softly, her voice carrying a tremor she herself hadn't noticed: 'Chen Ji, what did you see?' She could sense the剧烈的波动 within his Mental Sea, that trembling from the depths of his soul causing her heart to ache. She wanted to help him share the burden but found she couldn't touch the deepest secrets.
Chen Ji did not answer immediately. His consciousness再次沉入识海深处，这一次，他选择主动触碰那道封印。封印表面的纹路感应到他的靠近，微微亮起，一股冰冷的信息流涌入他的脑海——那是天道意志传来的信息，简短而傲慢：'游戏开始，第二轮。'

The three characters '第二轮' made Chen Ji's heart tighten. Ten thousand years ago, the first generation Chess Player had lost. And now, it was his turn to struggle in the second round. He didn't know what contingencies the first generation Chess Player had left, but he knew he couldn't repeat past mistakes. This time, he would win.

Chen Ji opened his eyes and looked at Su Qingyao. Her worry warmed his heart—that was an emotion he hadn't felt in a long time. He said softly: 'Qingyao, whatever happens next, I won't let you get hurt.' This was his promise, and also the bottom line he, as Chen family blood and the seventh Chess Player, must protect.
Upon hearing these words, Su Qingyao's eyes微微泛红。她没有说话，只是将陈机的手握得更紧了些。就在这时，陈机感到识海中的封印再次异动——那道暗紫色的纹路突然分裂成两道，一道留在原地，另一道竟然穿透了识海屏障，向着外界的某处疾驰而去。

Chen Ji's expression changed slightly. He immediately realized that the split seal was flying toward a specific target. According to the fuzzy sensation from the Tianji Record Fragment, that direction... was toward the direction of the Demonic Path Holy Sect. Where Ye Qing was. The seal's target was actually her.

Su Qingyao's exclamation rang in his ears—Chen Ji felt his consciousness being forcibly pulled by some kind of force.
